title: How a Juicer Works in 60 Seconds 🍊🌀 #shorts
description:
A centrifugal juicer turns fruit into juice in seconds. A sharp spinning disc shreds the fruit, and the basket spins thousands of times a minute, flinging juice through a fine mesh while the pulp stays behind. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#juicer #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A juicer can turn a whole apple into a glass of juice in just *a few seconds*.

steps.label: Chute
steps.text: First, the fruit drops down a wide *feed chute*, pushed onto a flat metal disc.

steps.label: Shred
steps.text: That disc is covered in *tiny sharp blades* that shred the fruit into wet pulp.

steps.label: Spin
steps.text: Below it, a motor spins the basket *thousands of times* every single minute.

steps.label: Mesh
steps.text: *Centrifugal force* flings the juice through a fine metal mesh, but the pulp can't pass.

steps.label: Split
steps.text: Juice flows out the *spout* into your glass, while dry pulp is thrown into a separate bin.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Shred, spin, *strain*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
